capabilities: Render interactive day, week, and month views
Display tasks on a dynamic day clock
Filter tasks by notes, folders, or tags
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.4.10+; mobile view is limited to day view only.
problem: Tasks are scattered across many notes, requiring users to manually open and merge multiple files to view daily, weekly, or monthly schedules.

relations.evidence: Ctrl/Cmd+hover uses Page Preview like note titles.

summary: A task calendar that aggregates tasks from multiple notes into a single, interactive view, allowing smooth zooming between day, week, and month views.
